narrative.intro: C J Mahan Construction has $215M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. C J Mahan Construction won 12 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $17.9M and obligations up 247.4% year over year. C J Mahan Construction obligations by fiscal year show prior-year totals of $66.4M in FY21, $7.2M in FY22, $24.1M in FY23, $52.9M in FY24, and $61.9M in FY25. C J Mahan Construction received $215M in FY26 obligations concentrated in a few NAICS markets, led by Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $212M, followed by Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction at $3M, and Ship Building and Repairing at $204K. The current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date), and the figures reported are contract obligations except where award-value figures are called out separately in award tables.

sections.heading: How concentrated are C J Mahan Construction's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: C J Mahan Construction's FY2026 obligations are highly concentrated. C J Mahan Construction has $215M in FY2026 obligations and $212M of that is in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. C J Mahan Construction's remaining FY2026 obligations are much smaller, including $3M in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction and $204K in Ship Building and Repairing.

sections.heading: How has C J Mahan Construction's annual federal business trended recently?
sections.body: C J Mahan Construction obligations rose to $215M in FY26 from $61.9M in FY25 and earlier totals of $52.9M in FY24, $24.1M in FY23, $7.2M in FY22, and $66.4M in FY21. C J Mahan Construction obligations are up 247.4% year over year, with 12 awards so far this fiscal year and an average award size of $17.9M.
